# webtables/print

> Print: writes an `int`, `u8`, `bool` or `str` and a newline to stdout.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/print.pkg) · translates [std/print](../std/print.md)

Each print is one or two `fd_write` calls, unbuffered, like bintables.
Numbers are converted in a buffer at address 64.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when value str`

```nasm
(call $__pk_print_str
{value}
)
@wasi
```

### `emit when value bool`

```nasm
(call $__pk_print_bool
{value}
)
@wasi
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(call $__pk_print_int
{value}
)
@wasi
```

Includes: [webtables/wasi](wasi.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
(func $__pk_print_int (param $v i64) (local $p i32) (local $u i64)
(local.set $p (i32.const 95))
(i32.store8 (local.get $p) (i32.const 10))
(local.set $u (local.get $v))
(if (i64.lt_s (local.get $v) (i64.const 0)) (then (local.set $u (i64.sub (i64.const 0) (local.get $v)))))
(loop $digit
(local.set $p (i32.sub (local.get $p) (i32.const 1)))
(i32.store8 (local.get $p) (i32.add (i32.const 48) (i32.wrap_i64 (i64.rem_u (local.get $u) (i64.const 10)))))
(local.set $u (i64.div_u (local.get $u) (i64.const 10)))
(br_if $digit (i64.ne (local.get $u) (i64.const 0))))
(if (i64.lt_s (local.get $v) (i64.const 0)) (then
(local.set $p (i32.sub (local.get $p) (i32.const 1)))
(i32.store8 (local.get $p) (i32.const 45))))
(drop (call $__pk_rw (i32.const 1) (i64.const 1) (i64.extend_i32_u (local.get $p)) (i64.extend_i32_u (i32.sub (i32.const 96) (local.get $p))))))
(func $__pk_print_str (param $s i64)
(drop (call $__pk_rw (i32.const 1) (i64.const 1) (i64.add (local.get $s) (i64.const 8)) (i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $s)))))
(drop (call $__pk_rw (i32.const 1) (i64.const 1) (i64.const 272) (i64.const 1))))
(func $__pk_print_bool (param $b i64)
(if (i64.ne (local.get $b) (i64.const 0))
(then (drop (call $__pk_rw (i32.const 1) (i64.const 1) (i64.const 256) (i64.const 5))))
(else (drop (call $__pk_rw (i32.const 1) (i64.const 1) (i64.const 264) (i64.const 6))))))
```
